key_provisions_or_claims: Adds definitions and type-approval fields for vehicles equipped with 24 GHz and 79 GHz short-range radar.
Amends certificate of conformity to record radar equipment.
From 1 July 2006 Member States may refuse registration of non-compliant new vehicles.
From 1 July 2013 registration, sale or entry into service of vehicles with 24 GHz radar is prohibited.
Member States must transpose by 30 June 2006.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 2005/49/EC amends EU vehicle EMC and type-approval directives to cover automotive short-range radar (24 GHz and 79 GHz), adding certificate of conformity fields and requiring a ban on registering vehicles with 24 GHz radar from 1 July 2013.
